title: Pure Parshath
summary: Pure Parshath Counter Trap and Fairy piercing beatdown deck, tying every incarnation of Airknight Parshath together with The Sanctuary in the Sky synergy. The strategy uses Fairy swarmers to establish Link and Synchro Parshath bosses, locking down opponent activations through unyielding Counter Traps that summon Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath and Avenging Knight Parshath while refilling the hand.

summary.title: Starters
points: The Agent of Creation - Venus pays LP to Special Summon up to three Mystical Shine Balls from hand or Deck, enabling a 1-card climb into Protector of The Agents - Moon and Link-3 Celestial Knightlord Parshath.

Diviner of the Herald dumps a Fairy monster from Deck to the GY on Normal Summon (such as Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath), raising its Level to 6 to tune with Level 2 Mystical Shine Ball into Avenging Knight Parshath.
Celestial Knightlord Parshath discards a card on Link Summon to search The Sanctuary in the Sky or any card that mentions it.
Bountiful Artemis draws a card every time a Counter Trap Card resolves.
Guiding Ariadne in the Pendulum Zone waives all LP and discard costs for Counter Traps like Rebirth of Parshath.

summary.title: Opening: Venus + Rebirth of Parshath
steps: Normal Summon The Agent of Creation - Venus, paying 1500 LP to Special Summon three copies of Mystical Shine Ball from your Deck.
Link two Mystical Shine Balls into Protector of The Agents - Moon, using its effect to send Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath from Deck to the GY.
Link Moon and the remaining Shine Ball into Link-3 Celestial Knightlord Parshath.
Activate Celestial Knightlord Parshath, discarding a card to search The Sanctum of Parshath from your Deck.
Activate The Sanctum of Parshath (treated as The Sanctuary in the Sky), granting 300 ATK/DEF to all Fairies and protecting your Set Spells and Traps from targeting and destruction.
Set Rebirth of Parshath (and Divine Punishment), ready to negate any opponent activation and trigger Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath's revival from your GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath (2800 ATK) Special Summons itself from hand or GY whenever you activate a Counter Trap Card or negate an activation by banishing two Fairies; it inflicts piercing damage and searches a Parshath card or Counter Trap on inflicting damage.

Avenging Knight Parshath is a Level 8 Synchro that can be cheated out directly by Rebirth of Parshath; once per turn, it switches an opponent's monster's battle position and inflicts piercing battle damage.
Celestial Knightlord Parshath searches Sanctuary support and banishes a Fairy from the GY to summon a higher-Level Fairy from hand when a Fairy is sent to the GY.
Airknight Parshath and Neo-Parshath, the Sky Paladin inflict piercing battle damage and draw a card each time they inflict battle damage.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Rebirth of Parshath negates any card or effect activation, shuffles that card into the Deck, and Special Summons a Parshath monster directly from your Deck or Extra Deck.
Divine Punishment negates and destroys any Spell, Trap, or monster effect at zero cost while The Sanctum of Parshath or The Sanctuary in the Sky is active.
The Sanctum of Parshath counts as The Sanctuary in the Sky, makes all Set Spells/Traps untargetable and indestructible, and recycles three Fairies or Counter Traps from the GY to the Deck.
Solemn Judgment and Solemn Warning provide omni-negation and summon denial while serving as reveals for Rebirth of Parshath.

main: Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath

Signature Level 9 LIGHT Fairy boss (2800 ATK): if you activate a Counter Trap Card OR negate the activation of a card/effect, you can banish 2 other Fairies from your hand/field/GY to Special Summon this card from your hand OR GY; inflicts piercing battle damage and searches ANY 'Parshath' card or Counter Trap when inflicting battle damage!
Airknight Parshath
Iconic original Level 5 LIGHT Fairy (1900 ATK): inflicts piercing battle damage when attacking a Defense Position monster, and draws 1 card every time it inflicts battle damage to your opponent!
Neo-Parshath, the Sky Paladin

Level 7 LIGHT Fairy: can be Special Summoned from your hand by Tributing 1 'Airknight Parshath' you control; inflicts piercing battle damage, draws 1 card when inflicting battle damage, and gains ATK and DEF equal to the difference in LP while The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the field!
Darknight Parshath
DARK counterpart of Airknight Parshath: gains 100 ATK per DARK monster in your GY and banishes 1 DARK monster from your GY when destroying a monster by battle to draw 1 card.
The Agent of Creation - Venus

One-card Link-3 Celestial Knightlord Parshath starter: pays LP to Special Summon Mystical Shine Balls from your hand/Deck, climbing through Link-2 Protector of The Agents - Moon into Link-3 Celestial Knightlord Parshath!
Mystical Shine Ball
Summoned by Venus to assemble Celestial Knightlord Parshath or tune with Level 6 Diviner of the Herald into Level 8 Avenging Knight Parshath.
Diviner of the Herald

Dumps Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath from your Deck to the GY on Normal Summon (becoming Level 6 to tune with Level 2 Mystical Shine Ball into Level 8 Avenging Knight Parshath, while putting Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath in your GY ready to revive when you flip a Counter Trap!).
Bountiful Artemis
Draws 1 card whenever Rebirth of Parshath, Divine Punishment, or Solemn Traps resolve.
Guiding Ariadne
Removes the 1000 LP and discard costs of Rebirth of Parshath while in the Pendulum Zone.
The Sanctum of Parshath

Signature Continuous Spell: treated as 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' while on the field or in the GY; boosts all Fairies by 300 ATK/DEF; makes all Set Spells/Traps on the field untargetable and indestructible; and shuffles 3 Fairies and/or Counter Traps from GY to Deck!
The Sanctuary in the Sky
Classic Field Spell searchable by Celestial Knightlord Parshath that reduces all battle damage you take from battles involving a Fairy monster to 0.
Rebirth of Parshath

Signature Counter Trap: when a card or effect is activated, reveals 1 Counter Trap in your hand, discards 1 card, and pays 1000 LP to negate the activation, shuffle that card into the Deck, AND Special Summon 1 'Parshath' monster directly from your Deck OR Extra Deck!
Divine Punishment
Counter Trap: negates and destroys any Spell, Trap, or monster effect while The Sanctum of Parshath or The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the field.
Solemn Judgment
Limited to 1 in TCG: reveals in hand to activate Rebirth of Parshath and triggers Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath in your GY.
Solemn Warning
Counter Trap: pays 2000 LP to negate a Summon or effect that summons, revealing in hand for Rebirth of Parshath and triggering Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath!
extra: Signature Link-3 LIGHT Fairy boss (2+ Fairy monsters; 2400 ATK): discards 1 card to add 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' or ANY card that mentions it from your Deck to your hand; when a face-up Fairy you control is sent to the GY, banishes 1 Fairy from GY to Special Summon a higher-Level Fairy from your hand!

Signature Level 8 LIGHT Fairy Synchro boss (2600 ATK): cheated out by Rebirth of Parshath or Synchro Summoned via Diviner + Shine Ball; once per turn changes the battle position of 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and inflicts piercing battle damage!
Link-2 LIGHT Fairy: sends The Sanctuary in the Sky or Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath from your Deck to the GY on Link Summon, and tributes 1 Fairy to destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
